newsitem.title: DENMARK: Superfos sees 97 profit up by 15-20 pct.
newsitem.headline: Superfos sees 97 profit up by 15-20 pct.

text.p: Danish construction, chemicals and packaging group Superfos A/S said on Thursday it expected 1997 profits, before tax and extraordinary items, to be between 15 and 20 percent higher than 1996's 325 million crowns.
Superfos said in a statement that its 1996 strategy formed the basis for the group's forward planning until 1999.

It said there was still major growth potential in the group's four core units - Superfos Construction US, Superfos Construction Europe, Superfos Packaging and Superfos Chemicals - as stated in the plan.

"The bulk of Superfos' planned growth is expected to come through the acquisition of new companies and activities. The organisational and financial basis for this growth is in place," it said. --Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33969652
